name: Impending Doom
description: '''Impending Doom''' is an American Christian [[deathcore]] band from [[Riverside, California|Riverside]], [[California]]. The group has released six full-length studio albums, and consists of Brook Reeves (vocals), Manny Contreras (guitars), David Sittig (bass) and Andrew Holzbaur (drums). Reeves and Contreras are the only two remaining original members. The band refers to their style as "gorship", a [[portmanteau]] of [[Graphic violence|gore]] and [[worship]].
